mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_device_group_relation WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT g.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_device_group_relation r WHERE r.group_id = g.id AND r.del_flag = '0') AS device_count FROM iot_device_group g WHERE g.parent_id = #{parentId} AND g.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY g.sort ASC, g.create_time ASC
